newsitem.title: USA: Seattle municipal electric utility plans new rates.
newsitem.headline: Seattle municipal electric utility plans new rates.

text.p: Seattle City Light proposed this week a two-year rate plan which includes rate cuts for large commerical users, but raises rates for residential customers.
Overall rates for the municipal utility would drop 1 percent.
Seattle's city council is expected to decide on the plan before the end of January so rates can go into effect at the next cycle on March 1, a spokesman for the utility said Friday.

The new plan includes an option for large customers to purchase power under market rates, the spokesman noted. "Large users will have the option to take market rates, but those who don't want to take the risk, don't have to."
